response.original_title: Room-Service_How Can I Add Another Room to My Carnival Cruise
response.overview: To add another room to an existing Carnival Cruise reservation, you must book a separate new stateroom and call Carnival Cruise Line customer service at+1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or contact your travel agent to link the two bookings. How the Process Works Separate Booking: You cannot add a physical room to an existing reservation online or through the app in one single transaction. Current Rates: +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) The new room will be priced at current market rates rather than the rate you secured for your original booking. Linking Reservations:+1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada)  Call customer support or your travel agent after booking the second room so they can place the reservations side-by-side or request connecting doors if available.
